name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding Interstage Inspection
intent: Inspect coat 1 for defects + touch-up. NO intercoat sanding — established exterior siding rule.
doctrine: Interstage between coat 1 and coat 2. Inspect qt_scaled (QT3:1500, QT4:800). Touch-up qt_scaled (QT3:2000, QT4:1000). NO intercoat sanding on exterior siding per established rule. For spray_backroll: also check T1-11 groove coverage.
